message.reasoning:
With only $6 and sitting on Tennessee, I'm worried about rolling into heavily developed spots like St. James or New York next turn. I should look at trading Pacific or Pennsylvania for quick cash to cover myself.

Selling Park Place to p3 would boost my cash but hand them the dark blue monopoly outright, which feels too risky — mortgaging later gives liquidity without that downside. My best shot is still the green set if North Carolina stays unowned, so I think the safest move is just ending the turn and mortgaging only if forced.
